info.name: Authorization Tokens Accounts fund reports - managed investment report API

params.name: locale
params.description: Language and locale, for example, en-US

items.docs: Get a Managed Investment Report for the fund specified in the `FundIdentifier` parameter.</br></br> Managed Investments Reports provide a qualitative assessment  of a fund carried out by Morningstar Research Analysts.</br></br>In the `pageSize` parameter, you can specify the page size for the returned PDF. Page size options are `Letter` or `A4`.</br></br>If a report exists, a presigned URL from which you can download the PDF is returned in the response.
